Rectangle labelled 12.4 cm (top) and 5.8 cm (side), with a 'Diagram not drawn accurately' caption, exactly as an AQA bounds question prints it. Labels match the problem values; the unknown (perimeter) is what the student finds.

No question text, solution, guided step, hint or misconception was changed in the figure pass beyond the fixes already logged in the guided changes file.
